why-odins.headline: Why Synthetic Doe Estrus Scent Beads Outperform Natural Urine
why-odins.body: Natural urine varies by batch. It soaks in, dilutes with rain, and degrades fast. Worse, it can carry CWD risk. Odin's synthetic beads fix every problem: identical concentration in every bottle, 30+ days continuous release (52% still active after 27 days), rainproof — moisture can't wash it away, no special storage needed, legal in all 50 states, CWD-safe, biodegradable polymer, zero trace left behind.

how-it-works.headline: How Biodegradable Scent Bead Technology Works
how-it-works.body: Plant-based polymer beads absorb synthetic scent and release it molecule-by-molecule when exposed to air. Lab testing confirms 52% concentration still releasing after 27 days. Set it once. Check your trail camera for weeks. No returns needed. Rain, snow, and dew simply protect the internal scent until air exposure resumes. Beads biodegrade naturally when done.

when-to-use.headline: When to Deploy Doe Estrus Scent Beads for Operational Efficiency
when-to-use.body: Pre-rut (Early–Mid October): Use scrape blends to condition areas. Save pure doe estrus for later. Seeking Phase (Late Oct–Early Nov): Deploy in travel corridors and scrape lines. Peak Rut (Mid–Late Nov): Apply 3 oz per 4'×4' zone. Pair with food-scent beads to anchor deer. Post-Rut (Dec–Jan): Maintain setups near food sources. Southern hunters: shift 1–2 months later.

how-to-use.headline: How to Use Odin's Doe Estrus Scent Beads and Liquid
how-to-use.beads: Sprinkle approximately 3 oz of synthetic doe estrus scent beads evenly across a 4' x 4' area in natural travel lanes, existing scrapes, or mock scrapes. The beads maintain continuous release for 30+ days regardless of weather conditions. Ideal placement includes areas visible to trail cameras for ongoing documentation with minimal site disturbance.
how-to-use.liquid: Use the 4 oz oil-based liquid to create directional trails leading to bead deployments. Apply along trails, on brush, or as needed for broader initial coverage. The formula supports 7–10 days per application and can be used on boot soles or equipment. Combining both formats provides immediate and sustained performance with reduced overall effort.

items.question: What is doe estrus scent?
items.answer: A synthetic replica of whitetail doe pheromones during estrus. Zero natural urine, zero CWD risk.

items.question: Is synthetic doe estrus as effective as natural urine?
items.answer: Yes. Engineered to precise specs with 10 seasons of field testing — no batch-to-batch variability.

items.question: When should I start using doe estrus scent beads?
items.answer: Late October through November for northern states. Use scrape blends earlier; shift 1–2 months later for southern latitudes.

items.question: How long does Odin's doe estrus scent last?
items.answer: 30+ days continuous release. University testing confirmed 52% concentration still active after 27 days.

items.question: Is synthetic deer scent legal where natural urine is banned?
items.answer: Yes. No cervid-derived ingredients means full legality in all 50 states.

items.question: What is CWD and why does it matter for scent products?
items.answer: Chronic Wasting Disease is a fatal deer condition transmitted through bodily fluids. Synthetic scents eliminate all risk.

items.question: Are Odin's scent beads biodegradable?
items.answer: Yes. Plant-based polymer breaks down naturally, like organic matter.
